subject.title: [Feature]: Proposal: Restructure VISION.md as a decision framework for humans and AI PR review

question: Should VISION.md become the product-thesis decision framework for contributors and AI review, or should AI-auditor criteria live elsewhere?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the accepted thesis wording and whether automated-review criteria belong in VISION.md are maintainer product/docs policy choices.

options.title: Approve concise VISION framework
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved thesis, reusable gut-check questions, and rationale-backed memory/security/lean-core guardrails to VISION.md, then align contributor surfaces only where criteria change.

options.title: Split auditor policy out
options.body: Keep VISION.md focused on product principles and put detailed AI-auditor rules in a separate review-policy document linked from contributor guidance.

options.title: Decline the rewrite
options.body: Leave VISION.md as a lightweight roadmap guardrail and close the request if maintainers do not want it to become a review decision contract.

recommendation.title: Approve concise VISION framework
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved thesis, reusable gut-check questions, and rationale-backed memory/security/lean-core guardrails to VISION.md, then align contributor surfaces only where criteria change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest VISION.md authorship, product-direction, and prior issue-engagement signal.
